## 4-4 Point

AKA star point; hoshi. The 4-4 point allows a player to establish a foothold in a corner while also enabling development of influence. 

Although the 4-4 point favors influence, it is not necessarily inefficient at securing territory. Players should be flexible with this move, ready to adjust their strategy to changing circumstances, at times using it to build influence, at other times going for territory. (p. 10.)
